name: Cleric
description: A cleric in long deep-blue robes with a white collar and a mace riding a white horse with a dark blue caparison.

name: Druid
description: A druid in a long green hooded robe with a gnarled wooden staff riding a light brown horse with a leafy green saddle cloth.

name: Alchemist
description: An alchemist in a tan and brown robe with leather pouches and glass flasks on his belt riding a light grey horse with a beige saddle cloth.

name: Demoniac
description: A demonic warrior in spiked dark red armour with a horned crested helmet riding a dark brown horse with a blood-red caparison.

name: Heretic
description: A heretic sorcerer in black and crimson robes with long dark hair riding a dark horse with a red caparison trimmed in black.

name: Death Knight
description: A death knight in black plate armour with a horned skull-like helmet and a long sword riding a pale white horse with a black tattered caparison.

name: Overlord
description: An overlord in dark steel armour with a horned helmet and a heavy sword riding a black horse with a red caparison.

name: Warlock
description: A warlock in a red hooded robe with long red hair and a dark staff riding a black horse with a red caparison.

name: Battle Mage
description: A battle mage in rough leather and fur with a horned headdress and a bone-tipped staff riding a beige horse with a pale caparison.

name: Beastmaster
description: A beastmaster in scaly green-brown leather armour with a spear riding a tan horse with a green caparison.

name: Witch
description: A swamp witch in a green hooded cloak with a crooked staff riding a tan horse with a mossy green caparison.

name: Planeswalker
description: A planeswalker warrior in orange-red elemental armour with flame-shaped plates riding a dark chestnut horse with a fiery orange caparison.

name: Elementalist
description: An elementalist in white and sky-blue robes with a crystal-tipped staff riding a white horse with a blue caparison.

name: Captain
description: A pirate captain in a long dark coat and a black tricorn hat with a cutlass riding a white horse with a red caparison.

name: Navigator
description: A navigator in a red sea coat and a bandana with a spyglass on the belt riding a white horse with a red caparison.

name: Mercenary
description: A mercenary gunslinger in a wide-brimmed hat and a long brown duster coat with a long rifle riding a brown horse with a red saddle cloth.

name: Artificer
description: An artificer with white hair and brass goggles in a red coat with tool belts and a small mechanical device riding a brown horse with a red saddle cloth.

name: Chieftain
description: A northern chieftain in thick furs and a steel helmet with a big axe riding a pale horse with a blue caparison.

name: Elder
description: A northern elder shaman with a white beard in fur robes and bone charms holding a rune staff riding a pale horse with a blue caparison.
